// Code generated by @uarp/codegen from spec/openapi.json. DO NOT EDIT.

import Foundation

/// Mutual recursion: a folder holds entries, an entry holds folders.
public struct Folder: Codable, Hashable, Sendable {
    public var name: String
    public var leaves: [Leaf]?

    public init(name: String, leaves: [Leaf]? = nil) {
        self.name = name
        self.leaves = leaves
    }

    private enum CodingKeys: String, CodingKey {
        case name = "name"
        case leaves = "leaves"
    }
}

/// The other half of the cycle.
public struct Leaf: Codable, Hashable, Sendable {
    public var title: String
    public var folders: [Folder]?

    public init(title: String, folders: [Folder]? = nil) {
        self.title = title
        self.folders = folders
    }

    private enum CodingKeys: String, CodingKey {
        case title = "title"
        case folders = "folders"
    }
}

/// A node that holds a list of itself — direct recursion.
public struct Tree: Codable, Hashable, Sendable {
    public var label: String
    public var children: [Tree]?

    public init(label: String, children: [Tree]? = nil) {
        self.label = label
        self.children = children
    }

    private enum CodingKeys: String, CodingKey {
        case label = "label"
        case children = "children"
    }
}
